messages:
tina.sre: PAGE: kv-cache-evictions-high in prod-west, multiple backends returning 503s. Incident bot attached the monitor and initial graphs.

devops-bot: <@tina.sre> paging oncall (level=primary) for monitor: https://dash.redwood.internal/monitor/kv-cache-evictions-high · query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (instance)` · fired 9 mins ago

alex.platform: On it. I see eviction rate spike coincident with a rolling deploy to pool-gpu-3 ~12:45 UTC. Traces show increased GC and swap activity on two nodes.

maya.prod-eng: Noting customer impact: multiple inference requests degrading to 502/503, small percentage (~0.6%) but steady. Sending heads-up to CS.

samir.ops: Quick mitigation: scaling KV service workers + temporary increased cache size on node-12. Pushing patch now.

alex.platform: Patch applied to node-12/13, eviction rate trending down on node-12, still high on node-13. Rolling restart of agent on node-13 in progress.

oncall-runbook-bot: Runbook step triggered: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-cache-evictions · Steps executed: 1) identify affected hosts 2) increase cache_size 3) restart agent 4) annotate dashboard. Please confirm closure steps.

maya.prod-eng: CS updated customers: "We've identified transient cache pressure during a deploy, mitigation in progress, no data loss, will follow up."

alex.platform: After restart node-13 eviction rate dropped to baseline, 503s resolved. Observability: P50 latency back to normal, P99 improving.

samir.ops: Recommending alert tuning: raise the alert threshold from 50 evictions/min to 120 evictions/min per-cluster and add a short refractory window (5m) to avoid paging on deploy spikes. Also add a composite condition: only page if 503s spike >0.3% simultaneously.

maya.prod-eng: Agree. Also want a dashboard panel showing deploys overlayed with eviction_rate to help correlation. Propose new panel link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/kv-cache/eviction-deploy-correlation

alex.platform: I'll open a PR to dashboards + the monitor change, and annotate the runbook with the deploy correlation notes and ownership.

tina.sre: Please include exact monitor config in PR and tag oncall for review. We need explicit owner for the alert (platform-team). Add runbook annotation: "when eviction spike correlates with deploy tag, do not page if 503s < 0.3% and spike < 5m".

samir.ops: I'll create the PR: https://git.redwood/infra/monitors/pulls/314 · includes updated thresholds, refractory window, and alert message with runbook link and ownership.

alex.platform: PR ready, requesting review from @tina.sre and @maya.prod-eng. Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infra/dashboards/pulls/88

oncall-runbook-bot: Annotation added to runbook: "2026-03-14: tuned threshold and added deploy-correlation guidance. Owner: platform-team. Reviewer: oncall SRE."

maya.prod-eng: Post-incident action items: 1) add deploy overlay panel, 2) implement composite alert condition, 3) add note to oncall playbook about temporary scaling vs restart, 4) schedule a short runbook review session next Tue.

tina.sre: Thanks team. Marking incident resolved. Closing page. :white_check_mark:

samir.ops: Follow-up: created a short dashboard alert test and added a unit test for monitor semantics. Links in PR description.

alex.platform: Filing a retro note in #postmortems with links to PRs and final configs.

maya.prod-eng: Leaving a final customer-facing summary in the CS follow-up doc.

tina.sre: All good — will close after PRs merge and runbook session scheduled.
